weakly supervised learning methods can be improved by incorporating strongly labeled data.
we propose a unified framework for supervised and weakly supervised learning which can leverage strongly labeled data for weakly labeled data.
we propose a novel framework for Supervised & Weakly Supervised (SWS) Learning which allows to leverage strongly and weakly supervised data simultaneously.

our proposed framework for Supervised Weakly Supervised learning is a promising approach for leveraging both strongly and weakly supervised data.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we show that a small amount (less than 5%) of strongly labeled data in conjunction with a large amount of weakly labeled data can significantly boost the performance of acoustic event and scene recognition.
we have proposed a novel learning framework which can be used for learning from weakly and fully supervised data.

our proposed method can learn from both types of data in a unified manner, it can learn from a small amount of weakly labeled data and it can learn from strongly labeled data even in the presence of weakly labeled ones.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a small amount (5%) of strongly labeled data is sufficient to achieve considerable improvement over only using weakly labeled training data.

the proposed unified learning framework can provide a general approach for addressing the problem of leveraging both weakly and strongly supervised data for a variety of problems in audio and other domains.
